conventions.slug: Ours, kebab-case, never derived by string munging. The 15 SCVAL slugs are unchanged (localStorage pins, /teams/<slug> URLs and fixture names depend on them).
conventions.abbr: Ours, 2 letters, UNIQUE across all 34 teams in all leagues. The 15 SCVAL abbrs are unchanged. New ones were chosen to avoid every existing abbr: Leigh LE / Leland LD; Prospect PS (PR = Presentation); Silver Creek SK (SC = Santa Clara); Westmont WM (WG = Willow Glen); Carmel CA (CU = Cupertino, CH = Christopher); Santa Catalina CT (SC taken; PCAL code CAT); Salinas SA (SG = Saratoga); Greenfield GR (GI = Gilroy).
conventions.acronym: MaxPreps schoolNameAcronym, copied verbatim. NOT unique: CHS = Cupertino/Christopher/Carmel, HHS = Homestead/Hollister, LHS = Lynbrook/Leigh/Leland, SHS = Saratoga/Stevenson/Salinas, SCHS = Santa Clara/Silver Creek/Santa Catalina, PHS = Presentation/Prospect, GHS = Gilroy/Greenfield. lib/teams.ts must STOP asserting acronym uniqueness and must STOP feeding acronyms into the BY_KEY alias table (only types.ts/snapshot-schema.ts/teams.ts use the field). SICP stays as an explicit alias of St. Ignatius.
conventions.aliases: Every spelling seen in MaxPreps (schoolName), si.com (team names), the official league pages/grids (BVAL docx headers, SCVAL PDF uppercase forms, CCS alignment), plus the '<Name> <Mascot>' and '<Name> High School' forms. Checked: no two teams share a normalizeTeamKey() key across [id, slug, name, shortName, aliases].
conventions.officialCodes: NEW optional field. Short codes used only inside an official fixture grid (PCAL PDF: CAR/GRE/HOL/MON/SAL/CAT/SCAT/STE; BVAL docx: 'WG'). Kept OUT of aliases on purpose so 2-3 letter tokens never enter the global resolver; a per-league grid parser should map them.
conventions.division: DivisionId strings are globally unique: de-anza, el-camino (SCVAL, unchanged), mt-hamilton, santa-teresa (BVAL), pcal (PCAL's single division; MaxPreps calls it 'Pacific Coast - Gabilan', which is NOT a PCAL field hockey division name and must not be shown to users). 'santa-teresa' is a DIVISION id; Santa Teresa High School (a BVAL member) does not field field hockey.
conventions.colors: schoolColor1/schoolColor2 from the MaxPreps league standings row, hex without '#'. Prospect is not in any standings table, so its colours come from teams/{id}/sportseasons/{ssid}/v1. Several unrelated schools share 222222/C8880A (likely MaxPreps defaults).
conventions.dataCoverage: 'full' = schedule-calculated returned >= 1 row on 2026-10-02 (SCVAL counts from repo fixtures). All 34 are 'full'.
conventions.shortName: <= 14 chars for the 176px control; no same-named schools exist among the 34, so no '(City)' qualifiers were needed. 'Santa Catalina' is exactly 14 and 'Silver Creek' 12: PICKER_BREAKS must be re-measured.

ccs.format: Single elimination, two divisions of 8: overall ranks 1-8 -> Division 1, 9-16 -> Division 2 (seeds display 1-8 within each). High seed (bottom line) hosts QF and SF per bylaws; live iCal says SF/F at neutral sites -> treat SF/F sites as TBD.
ccs.selectionCommittee: ADAC rep + 2 SCVAL + 2 BVAL + 1 PCAL; criteria (no order): head to head, common opponent, significant wins, strength of league, league finish, strength of schedule; avoid first-round league-mates 'if possible'.
ccs.overtime: Two 10-minute 7v7 sudden-victory periods, then 5-player shootouts, then a second shootout round, then sudden victory: a playoff game can show a tied score with a winner ('(W)' on MaxPreps).
